A zine is made with scissors, glue and a borrowed photocopier. ==Nothing has to line up.==

![[road.png]]

## Issue one

Fold an A4 sheet into eight pages, and fill them before the copy shop closes.

> Print fifty, give away forty-nine.

> [!tip] Stapler
> A long-arm stapler reaches the fold.

### What you need

- scissors
- a glue stick
- `toner`, lots of it
